title: Design Twitter
goal: Solve Design Twitter: Maintain user relationships and timestamped posts, then merge recent posts from the user and followed accounts into a feed.
strategy: Maintain user relationships and timestamped posts, then merge recent posts from the user and followed accounts into a feed.
edgeCases: Following or unfollowing changes future feeds; a user still sees their own posts.
inputRules: operations must be an array of strings, e.g. ["postTweet","getNewsFeed"]
params must be an object, e.g. {"postTweet":[[1,1]]}
